summary.en: Kogoro and Conan happens to walk by a famous writer's house. They see patrol cars surrounding the house and meet Megure and Takagi. Takagi reveals the famous writer was found shot to death in his house. Both Kogoro and Conan check the crime scene with Megure and Takagi.

suspects: Naoya Akaike, Miyuki Degawa, Ryunosuke Bito, and Haruo Chigasaki
suspectsZh: 赤池直也、出川美雪、尾藤龙之介与茅崎春夫
